+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+DEFAULT_OPENAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DocumentClientConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str = DEFAULT_OPENAI_BASE_URL
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
+    timeout: float = 60.0
+
+
+def load_document_client_config(
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    timeout: Optional[float] = None,
+) -> DocumentClientConfig:
+    resolved_api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
+    resolved_base_url = base_url or os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_OPENAI_BASE_URL)
+    resolved_model = model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
+    resolved_timeout = float(timeout if timeout is not None else os.environ.get("DOCUMENT_CLIENT_TIMEOUT", 60.0))
+    if not resolved_api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return DocumentClientConfig(
+        api_key=resolved_api_key,
+        base_url=resolved_base_url.rstrip("/"),
+        model=resolved_model,
+        timeout=resolved_timeout,
+    )
+
+
+class DocumentExtractionClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[DocumentClientConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or load_document_client_config()
+        self._session = requests.Session()
+        self._session.headers.update(
+            {
+                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.api_key}",
+                "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            }
+        )
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._session.close()
+
+    def request_json(self, payload: Dict[str, Any], path: str = "/responses") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        body = dict(payload)
+        body.setdefault("model", self.config.model)
+        response = self._session.post(
+            f"{self.config.base_url}{path}",
+            json=body,
+            timeout=self.config.timeout,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def _provider_client() -> requests.Session:
+    session = requests.Session()
+    session.headers.update(
+        {
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        }
+    )
+    return session
+
+
+def _build_prompt(document: Dict[str, Any], required_fields: List[str], min_confidence: float) -> str:
+    payload = {
+        "document": document,
+        "required_fields": required_fields,
+        "min_confidence": min_confidence,
+    }
+    return (
+        "Validate the following structured document fields and return only valid JSON with keys "
+        "is_valid, missing_fields, low_confidence_fields, errors. "
+        "A field is required if it is listed in required_fields. "
+        "A field is low confidence if confidence is present and below min_confidence. "
+        "If confidence is missing for a required field, treat it as low confidence.\n"
+        + json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
+    )
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(
+    document: Dict[str, Any],
+    required_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+    min_confidence: float = 0.8,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    required_fields = required_fields or ["vendor", "date", "total"]
+    prompt = _build_prompt(document, required_fields, min_confidence)
+    client = _provider_client()
+    response = client.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(
+            {
+                "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+                "input": prompt,
+                "temperature": 0,
+            }
+        ),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    text = ""
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        if "output_text" in data and isinstance(data["output_text"], str):
+            text = data["output_text"]
+        else:
+            outputs = data.get("output", [])
+            for item in outputs:
+                for content in item.get("content", []):
+                    if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                        text += content.get("text", "")
+    parsed = json.loads(text) if text else {}
+    return {
+        "is_valid": bool(parsed.get("is_valid", False)),
+        "missing_fields": parsed.get("missing_fields", []),
+        "low_confidence_fields": parsed.get("low_confidence_fields", []),
+        "errors": parsed.get("errors", []),
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+    }
*** End Patch

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _strip_code_fences(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.strip()
+    if text.startswith("```"):
+        text = text.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in text else ""
+        if text.endswith("```"):
+            text = text[:-3]
+    return text.strip()
+
+
+def _coerce_float(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return float(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        cleaned = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not cleaned:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return float(cleaned)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _coerce_int(value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        cleaned = value.strip()
+        if not cleaned:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return int(float(cleaned))
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _parse_items(items: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(items, list):
+        return []
+    normalized: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for item in items:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "description": item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("text"),
+                "quantity": _coerce_float(item.get("quantity")),
+                "unit_price": _coerce_float(item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price") or item.get("amount")),
+                "total": _coerce_float(item.get("total") or item.get("line_total") or item.get("amount")),
+            }
+        )
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _local_normalize(expense: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    normalized = {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "normalized_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "currency": expense.get("currency") or expense.get("transaction_currency"),
+        "vendor": expense.get("vendor") or expense.get("merchant") or expense.get("payee"),
+        "date": expense.get("date") or expense.get("transaction_date") or expense.get("receipt_date"),
+        "subtotal": _coerce_float(expense.get("subtotal")),
+        "tax": _coerce_float(expense.get("tax") or expense.get("tax_amount")),
+        "tip": _coerce_float(expense.get("tip")),
+        "total": _coerce_float(expense.get("total") or expense.get("grand_total") or expense.get("amount")),
+        "notes": expense.get("notes") or expense.get("memo") or expense.get("description"),

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_invoice_fields.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text: str, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    model_name = model or os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini")
+    schema = {
+        "name": "invoice_fields",
+        "schema": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "vendor": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "date": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "total": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                "line_items": {
+                    "type": "array",
+                    "items": {
+                        "type": "object",
+                        "properties": {
+                            "description": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                            "quantity": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                            "unit_price": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                            "amount": {"type": ["number", "string", "null"]},
+                        },
+                        "required": ["description", "quantity", "unit_price", "amount"],
+                        "additionalProperties": False,
+                    },
+                },
+            },
+            "required": ["vendor", "date", "total", "line_items"],
+            "additionalProperties": False,
+        },
+        "strict": True,
+    }
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model_name,
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Extract invoice vendor, date, total, and line-item fields as structured JSON.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": invoice_text},
+        ],
+        text={"format": {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": schema}},
+    )
+    return response.output_parsed  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields_from_text(invoice_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text)
*** End Patch
